description: Full text of one MHRA safety alert or recall from GOV.UK, given the alert URL or path returned by mhra_safety_alerts. Returns the complete notice as plain text — for a medicines recall that means the affected batch numbers and expiry dates, the marketing authorisation (PL) number, the active ingredient, the recall class and the action the recipient must take — plus the issue date, alert category and any withdrawal notice.

url.description: The alert URL or GOV.UK path, e.g. "/drug-device-alerts/class-2-medicines-recall-zentiva-pharma-uk-limited-fingolimod-zentiva-0-dot-5-mg-capsules-el-26-a-slash-37" or the full https://www.gov.uk/... form.
